name: Uncertainty-Guided Residual Learning for 3DGS
definition: A residual learning strategy tailored for 3DGS that amplifies gradient flow to weakly contributing, high-uncertainty Gaussians by combining full and uncertainty-intensified renders, acting similarly to ResNet skip connections.
summary: Uncertainty-Guided Residual Learning is a 3D Gaussian Splatting training strategy that amplifies gradients for weakly contributing Gaussians by combining full-scene and uncertainty-intensified renders to address vanishing gradients in underrepresented regions.
